description: This Java class 'AlarmEdgeProcessor' handles processing of alarm-related messages and events within the Thingsboard platform, specifically for edge computing scenarios. It manages conversion between internal alarm data and edge protocol messages, processes incoming alarm updates from edges, and propagates alarm events to related edges.

classes.name: AlarmEdgeProcessor
classes.description: Handles processing of alarm messages and events for edge synchronization in Thingsboard.

methods.name: processAlarmMsgFromEdge
methods.description: Processes incoming alarm messages from edge devices.

methods.name: convertEdgeEventToDownlink
methods.description: Converts an edge event into a downlink message to be sent to edge devices.

methods.name: processEntityNotification
methods.description: Handles notifications about alarm entity changes, such as deletion or updates, from edge devices.

methods.name: convertAlarmEventToAlarmMsg
methods.description: Converts an internal edge event into an alarm update message for edge communication.

methods.name: getEdgeEventType
methods.description: Returns the type of edge event this processor handles, which is ALARM.
